title: History-informed Lagrangian Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.13215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecasting the long-horizon evolution of mechanical systems from position-only observations is a pivotal yet difficult task, as hidden velocities and trajectory-specific physical properties must be inferred simultaneously. Although physics-guided neural networks like Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) guarantee physical plausibility, they generally require complete state inputs and lack adaptability to changing system parameters. To break these limitations, we introduce History-informed Lagrangian Neural Networks (HiLNN). Grounded in the insight that temporal position sequences implicitly encode underlying dynamics, HiLNN employs a recurrent encoder to extract a latent context from history. This context not only reconstructs the unobserved initial velocity but also adaptively modulates the mass matrix, potential energy, and damping coefficients of a structured Lagrangian system. translated_title: 历史信息启发的拉格朗日神经网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13215v1 公告类型：新 摘要：从仅位置观测中预测机械系统的长时间演化是一项关键但困难的任务，因为必须同时推断隐藏速度和轨迹特定的物理属性。尽管像拉格朗日神经网络（LNNs）这样的物理引导神经网络保证了物理合理性，但它们通常需要完整的状态输入，并且缺乏对变化系统参数的适应性。为了打破这些限制，我们引入了历史信息启发的拉格朗日神经网络（HiLNN）。基于时间位置序列隐含编码底层动态的洞见，HiLNN采用一个循环编码器从历史中提取潜在上下文。该上下文不仅重建未观测的初始速度，还自适应地调制结构化拉格朗日系统的质量矩阵、势能和阻尼系数。通过利用可微分的RK4滚动方案，整个系统得以端到端训练。
tldr: 本论文提出HiLNN，通过循环编码器从历史位置序列中提取潜在上下文，同时推断初始速度和自适应调整物理参数，从而在仅位置观测下实现长时程机械系统预测，并克服了传统LNNs对完整状态和固定参数的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HiLNN, which uses a recurrent encoder to extract latent context from historical position sequences, simultaneously inferring initial velocity and adaptively modulating physical parameters, enabling long-horizon mechanical system forecasting from position-only observations and overcoming LNNs' reliance on full states and fixed parameters.
